title: Internal: Transferring Funds Between Bank Accounts
summary: Describes the internal tool transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to move USD between a customer’s checking or savings accounts (source_account_id to destination_account_id). Requires both accounts be ACTIVE/OPEN, source has sufficient funds, amount is positive USD, IDs are distinct, and same-customer/authorization; insufficient funds return an error.
faqs: What tool do agents use to transfer money between my checking and savings accounts?
What are the requirements before the transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 call (account status, sufficient funds, same customer, authorization, valid positive USD amount, distinct IDs)?
What happens if I try to transfer more than the source account has available (insufficient funds error)?
When should an agent use this tool to fund a new savings account opening deposit?
When should the agent use this tool to consolidate balances before closing an account?
What post-transfer checks should an agent perform to confirm the transfer posted and no duplicate was initiated?
keywords: funding new savings account opening deposit
moving funds between accounts at customer request
